Registration information

  • Please ensure you read the Terms & Conditions and Cancellations & Withdrawal Policy before registering.
  • Prices are in INR and include 18% GST + processing fees.
  • Athletes who register 60 days before the race will not have race materials personalized (name on merchandise apparel and name on race bib.) Athletes will also not be assigned a bib number until Athlete Check-In.
  • This event offers qualifying slots to the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship.
  • Athletes must be 18 years of age on race day. 
  • Only one entry per email address is accepted. Please ensure you have access to a unique email address to process your registration.

Online registrations are synced to our database within 24 hours. You will automatically receive a registration confirmation e-mail from our registration partner.  
 
Your age group category for the event you registered for will be reflective of your age as of 31 December of the event year. 

You can sign in to your IRONMAN profile to check your registration status at any time, below: 
My IRONMAN profile >> 

Your name, and the names of other starters will be searchable on the IRONMAN Tracker App the day prior to your race. 

All registrations are non-refundable after the specified cancellation dates. Registrations are non-transferable.

Athletes confirmed in the race who wish to withdraw, must do so in writing to the race office via email at [email protected]

Refund policy for new athletes who registered in the 2027 IRONMAN 70.3 Amdavad:

  • Any requests received on or before 14th November 2026 11:59pm IST will be eligible for a 50% refund of event entry fee paid.

  • Any requests received between 15th November 2026 to 31st December 2026 11:59pm IST will be eligible for a 25% refund of event entry fee paid. 

  • Any requests received after 31st December 2026 will not be eligible for a refund under any circumstances.

Relay Team Changes Request:

  • Any additional requests would be charged at 10000 INR per change.

All partial refund requests must be confirmed by the deadlines provided and requested via email to the event specific email.  

Any additional purchases including but not limited to; Processing Fees paid at the time of entry are non-refundable at any time.
